guide.lead: How to start and how to use Orbek.
guide.1: Download Orbek.exe from the project page, put it in a folder of its own and run it. Its icon appears next to the clock.
guide.2: On the Setup tab Orbek downloads Node.js and Vencord, puts the plugin in, builds it and hooks it into Discord. It takes a few minutes.
guide.3: After the setup Discord starts again with the Orbek plugin. “Discord connected” turns green at the bottom of the window.
guide.4: Games, Videos and For Orbs tabs, sorting and a cosmetics filter. Every quest shows its rewards, progress and time left.
guide.5: “Accept quest” takes the quest. When it is completed, click “Claim in Discord” – you claim the reward on the quests page (there is a captcha).
guide.6: In Settings you can let Orbek do quests by itself, several at once. Discord forbids this and may take the rewards back or ban the account.
guide.7: Switch the view to “Mini” or open “Small window” to see just the rewards and progress rings.
guide.8: Orbek updates itself from GitHub. When a newer plugin is out you will see an “Update plugin” bar.
